categories.name: Build
categories.description: Everything needed to compile source into `dist/` — from a full clean rebuild to incremental UI-only transpilation and file watching.

categories.name: Development
categories.description: Run and explore the CLI during day-to-day development.

categories.name: Release
categories.description: Scripts for cutting and publishing new versions of the package.

categories.name: Testing
categories.description: All Vitest-based test commands, from a single CI pass to interactive watch mode and per-layer targeted runs.

allTasks.name: build
allTasks.description: Wipes `dist/`, recreates `dist/lib/`, copies the full `lib/` source tree and `index.js`, then transpiles the three JSX UI components via esbuild (overwriting the raw copies). Run before publishing or before running the CLI from `dist/`.

allTasks.name: build:ui
allTasks.description: Transpiles only the three JSX UI components (`TaskPicker`, `AutoComplete`, `PluginPicker`) into `dist/lib/ui/` using esbuild. Much faster than a full `build` when only the TUI layer changed and the rest of `dist/` is already current.

allTasks.name: watch
allTasks.description: Starts a nodemon watcher over `lib/` and `index.js`. On any `.js` change it runs the full `bun.build.mjs` so `dist/` stays in sync automatically. Use during active development alongside a separate terminal running `fsr`.

allTasks.name: fsr
allTasks.description: Launches the built CLI directly from `dist/index.js`. Use after a `build` to smoke-test the compiled output or to open the interactive task picker.

allTasks.name: start
allTasks.description: Builds the project from source, then immediately launches the interactive CLI. The safe all-in-one command for starting a fresh development session when you want a clean build first.

allTasks.name: start:run
allTasks.description: Launches the CLI from `dist/index.js` without rebuilding. Use when `dist/` is already up to date and you just need to reopen the picker without the overhead of a full build.

allTasks.name: release
allTasks.description: Bumps the version in `package.json` via `fsr bump` (which handles the git tag as well), then rebuilds `dist/` so the published package reflects the new version. Run when you are ready to cut a new release before publishing to npm.
allTasks.script: fsr run-s release:bump build release:commit release:publish

allTasks.name: release:publish
allTasks.description: Runs `lib/release/publish.js`, which handles the full npm publish workflow — sets the dist-tag, calls `npm publish`, and executes any post-publish steps. Run after `release` to push the new version to the registry.

allTasks.name: test
allTasks.description: Runs the full test suite once with Vitest in non-watch (CI) mode. Exits with a non-zero code on failure, making it safe for CI pipelines.

allTasks.name: test:watch
allTasks.description: Starts Vitest in interactive watch mode. Re-runs only the affected tests on every file save — the fastest feedback loop during active development.

allTasks.name: test:coverage
allTasks.description: Runs the full test suite once and generates a V8 coverage report via `@vitest/coverage-v8`. Writes HTML/JSON details to `coverage/`. Use before a release or PR to verify coverage targets.

allTasks.name: test:coverage:open
allTasks.description: Generates the V8 coverage report and opens the HTML dashboard (`coverage/index.html`) in your default browser. Cross-platform (macOS/Windows/Linux). Unlike `test:coverage`, it ignores the exit code so the report still opens even when tests fail or coverage thresholds are not met — useful for inspecting gaps while iterating.
